principle: Generic procession reader renders only recovered following-action states. Feast/procession-specific texts must be supplied by a dedicated proper/profile and are never fabricated here.

source.authority: RG60 §§507–510 + recovered generic following-action processional contract

readerSurfaces.title: Procession begins
readerSurfaces.guide: The Mass is complete. Join the following procession only if this procession is actually taking place and you are participating.

readerSurfaces.title: During the procession
readerSurfaces.guide: Follow the local procession and its proper texts. This generic reader deliberately does not invent feast-specific chants or responses.

readerSurfaces.title: Procession complete
readerSurfaces.guide: The following action is complete. Return to the post-Mass lifecycle.
